A CHANGE OF PERSPECTIVE

The world follows
your eyes.

Walk the floating paths, gather every light fragment, and step through the white arch.

01

Find your footing. Use WASD to walk, or click a connected solid tile. Drag to rotate the overview or look around in first person. Q/E also turns the view; on touch, swipe to look.

02

Turn the world. Press Space or choose a perspective. In the 3D overview, amber paths are solid. In first person, blue paths become real.

03

Trust the white stone. White platforms exist in both realities. Shift on one to stay safe. If you fall, you return to your last white platform. From chamber 7, stand on a circular hub in overview and press F or Turn island to rotate its amber paths.

04

Complete the ring. From chamber 13, stand on a white stone marked with two circles. Enter first person, then drag or use the Look arrows (I/J/K/L) to align the two arcs. Press F or Bind seal to open its blue bridge. Bind every seal before reaching the arch.
